title: Skyledger History
description: Flights, long-term trends and weather aloft, from the history import.

panels.title: Flight log
panels.description: Every flight that started in the range, newest first (500 max). Entered/left at: bearing from the receiver where it was first and last heard. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.first_seen AS "first seen", f.callsign, al.name AS airline, d.registration,
  d.type_code AS type, d.description,
  extract(epoch FROM f.last_seen - f.first_seen)::float8 AS duration,
  f.min_alt AS lowest, f.closest_nm AS closest,
  round(f.entry_bearing)::int AS "entered at", round(f.exit_bearing)::int AS "left at"
FROM flights f
LEFT JOIN aircraft_db d USING (hex)
LEFT JOIN airlines al ON al.code = substring(f.callsign FROM '^([A-Z]{3})[0-9]')
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.first_seen)
ORDER BY f.first_seen DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Flights per day
panels.description: Flights starting each local day. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', first_seen, (SELECT value FROM db_meta WHERE key = 'tz')) AS time, count(*) AS flights
FROM flights WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: New aircraft per day
panels.description: Aircraft seen for the first time ever that day. The first weeks of history count everything as new. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', first_ever, (SELECT value FROM db_meta WHERE key = 'tz')) AS time, count(*) AS "new aircraft"
FROM (SELECT hex, min(first_seen) AS first_ever FROM flights GROUP BY hex) a
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_ever) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flights per hour, last 7 days
panels.description: Flights starting in each local hour, one row per day, oldest on top; darker is busier. Move the dashboard time range back to page through earlier weeks. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT first_seen AT TIME ZONE (SELECT value FROM db_meta WHERE key = 'tz') AS t FROM flights WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen))
SELECT to_char(t::date, 'Dy DD Mon') AS day,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 0) AS "00",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 1) AS "01",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 2) AS "02",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 3) AS "03",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 4) AS "04",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 5) AS "05",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 6) AS "06",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 7) AS "07",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 8) AS "08",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 9) AS "09",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 10) AS "10",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 11) AS "11",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 12) AS "12",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 13) AS "13",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 14) AS "14",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 15) AS "15",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 16) AS "16",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 17) AS "17",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 18) AS "18",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 19) AS "19",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 20) AS "20",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 21) AS "21",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 22) AS "22",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM t) = 23) AS "23"
FROM f GROUP BY t::date ORDER BY t::date

panels.title: Regulars
panels.description: Aircraft with the most flights in the range. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.registration, d.type_code AS type, d.description, count(*) AS flights,
  mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.callsign) AS "usual callsign", max(f.last_seen) AS "last seen"
FROM flights f LEFT JOIN aircraft_db d USING (hex)
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.first_seen)
GROUP BY f.hex, d.registration, d.type_code, d.description ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Rare visitors
panels.description: Flights in the range by aircraft types seen on 3 days or fewer in all history. Flights split where an aircraft went unheard for over 30 minutes; rebuilt nightly, so today shows tomorrow.

targets.rawSql:
WITH type_days AS (
  SELECT d.type_code, count(DISTINCT f.first_seen::date) AS days
  FROM flights f JOIN aircraft_db d USING (hex) WHERE d.type_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT f.first_seen AS "first seen", f.callsign, d.registration, d.type_code AS type, d.description,
  t.days AS "days ever seen", f.closest_nm AS closest
FROM flights f JOIN aircraft_db d USING (hex) JOIN type_days t USING (type_code)
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.first_seen) AND t.days <= 3
ORDER BY f.first_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Aircraft per day
panels.description: Distinct aircraft each day. From the receiver's own replay history, 1 sample per aircraft per minute, local days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, aircraft FROM daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Furthest reception per day
panels.description: Longest range each day; a step change usually means the antenna, cable or gain changed. From the receiver's own replay history, 1 sample per aircraft per minute, local days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, max_range_nm AS "max range" FROM daily_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Busiest hour
panels.description: Local hour with the most distinct aircraft each day. From the receiver's own replay history, 1 sample per aircraft per minute, local days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, busiest_hour AS "busiest hour" FROM daily_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(day) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind speed
panels.description: Median wind speed reported by aircraft, per altitude band. Aircraft derive it from airspeed, heading and ground track, so it is only as good as their instruments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), CASE WHEN alt_baro < 10000 THEN 'below 10k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 20000 THEN '10k-20k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 30000 THEN '20k-30k ft' ELSE '30k ft and up' END AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wind_speed) AS value
FROM positions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND wind_speed IS NOT NULL AND alt_baro IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Outside air temperature
panels.description: Median static air temperature reported by aircraft, per altitude band.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), CASE WHEN alt_baro < 10000 THEN 'below 10k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 20000 THEN '10k-20k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 30000 THEN '20k-30k ft' ELSE '30k ft and up' END AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oat) AS value
FROM positions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND oat IS NOT NULL AND alt_baro IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wind direction
panels.description: Direction the wind blows FROM, circular mean per altitude band (0/360 north, 270 west). A steady westerly at 30k ft and up is the jet stream.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, CASE WHEN d < 0 THEN d + 360 ELSE d END AS value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), CASE WHEN alt_baro < 10000 THEN 'below 10k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 20000 THEN '10k-20k ft' WHEN alt_baro < 30000 THEN '20k-30k ft' ELSE '30k ft and up' END AS metric,
    degrees(atan2(avg(sin(radians(wind_dir))), avg(cos(radians(wind_dir))))) AS d
  FROM positions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND wind_dir IS NOT NULL AND alt_baro IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) w ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top operators
panels.description: Distinct aircraft per registered operator (tar1090 database).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.operator, count(DISTINCT p.hex) AS aircraft
FROM positions p JOIN aircraft a USING (hex)
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND a.operator IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top aircraft types
panels.description: Distinct aircraft per ICAO type code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.type_code AS type, max(a.description) AS description, count(DISTINCT p.hex) AS aircraft
FROM positions p JOIN aircraft a USING (hex)
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time) AND a.type_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 15
